reviewer: Independent GPT-6.1 Sol experience reviewer; automated browser assessment, not a human study
build: Build 05 as served during this review

ratings.reason: The added spatial guidance, persistent readable archive, cleaner combat messaging, and named victory manifest form a coherent usable prototype. The underlying repeated courtyard, simplified drone/weapon art, lack of authored character/weapon performance and limited content still prevent a top-tier production presentation. These UI improvements do not establish AAA readiness.

methods: Installed Chrome headless via Playwright with actual WebGL rendering; inspected screenshots at 1440×900 and 1280×800.

Normal controls with active enemies: deployment, four 2.2-second W/A/D/W movement segments, RMB aim and LMB fire for 1.4 seconds. No debug arrangements during that segment. Final state: 11.3829 simulated seconds, health 76, shield 0, ammo 17, kills 0.

Targeted presentation arrangements after the normal segment: debug enemy clearing and core recovery to inspect all memory records, pause archive and victory. This is not an unassisted mission completion.
Opened the archive through the actual pause button, inspected all three quotes, resized the viewport, closed and resumed, then arranged extraction to inspect the result manifest.
Read notification routing source to identify the remaining reload-completion center notice; this source finding was not separately exercised.
verifiedImprovements: Named goal/distance markers and larger functional HUD remain readable in the actual combat screenshot.
Pause archive preserves all three full quotes and fits at 1440×900 and 1280×800 without horizontal overflow; archive height is 701.75 px at both sizes.
Victory manifest names Mara Solberg, Elian Vale and Sera Nord with their roles; the combat summary is visible.
Routine kill/supply center banners are excluded by the current onEvent routing.
No uncaught browser exceptions occurred during review.

remainingFindings.status: confirmed from rendered results and source
remainingFindings.problem: After victory, names are plain manifest text and result actions are only Deploy Again / Return to Title. Full recovered quotes cannot be reopened from results; archive access is only in pause.
remainingFindings.recommendation: Provide Read Memories on results, or make each manifest entry open the existing archive.

remainingFindings.problem: Reload completion still emits notice “Weapon ready”, and notice routing still replaces the center announcement.
remainingFindings.recommendation: Use a reloadComplete event/feed only, or suppress this routine notice at center.

remainingFindings.problem: At 1280×800, the max-height 736 px result panel has clientHeight 734 and scrollHeight 737, producing 3 px of internal overflow although both buttons remain visible.
remainingFindings.recommendation: Trim a small amount of result spacing at short desktop heights, or accept intentional scrolling. No functional blocker was observed.

largerLimits: Environment remains an open repeated slab/prop courtyard; bespoke spaces, encounter staging and authored environmental storytelling are limited.
Weapon and drone are readable original assets but have simplified shapes/materials and no demonstrated production character/hands animation.
This review did not assess sound perceptually; audio/voice performance and cross-device hardware performance are not independently validated.
No human audience feedback, campaign content depth, broad accessibility or platform quality validation. A 10/10 or AAA-readiness claim is not supported.
